description: This file implements mathematical functions related to the Gamma family, including computation of log Gamma, regularized gamma functions, digamma, trigamma, the Lanczos approximation, and Gamma function itself, as part of the org.apache.commons.math3.special package.

classes.name: Gamma
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for computing gamma-related functions, including log gamma, incomplete gamma functions, digamma, trigamma, Lanczos approximation, and the Gamma function itself.

methods.name: logGamma
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of the gamma function for x > 0, using different algorithms based on the value of x.

methods.name: regularizedGammaP
methods.description: Calculates the regularized lower incomplete gamma function P(a, x) using series expansion or continued fractions.

methods.name: regularizedGammaQ
methods.description: Calculates the regularized upper incomplete gamma function Q(a, x) using continued fractions or series expansion.

methods.name: digamma
methods.description: Calculates the digamma function (the derivative of log gamma) for a given x, with approximations for different ranges.

methods.name: trigamma
methods.description: Calculates the trigamma function (second derivative of log gamma) for a given x.

methods.name: lanczos
methods.description: Computes the Lanczos approximation sum used for gamma function calculations.

methods.name: invGamma1pm1
methods.description: Computes 1 / Gamma(1 + x) - 1 for -0.5 <= x <= 1.5, based on NSWC library implementation.

methods.name: gamma
methods.description: Calculates the gamma function, using recursion and Lanczos approximation, with reflection formula for negative x.
